---
title: "CKG Scrape"
---

CKG Scrape is the project software pipeline that harvests and normalises the
IPCC AR6 web corpus, then prepares and loads the content into the ClimateKG
stack (MediaWiki + Wikibase).

## What it does

- Scrapes AR6 corpus content from web sources
- Normalises report structure and metadata
- Produces structured content and linked open data for KG loading
- Supports reuse on other web corpora (with custom ETL scripting)
